title: His Majesty Launches an Ancient Tradition into a New Era
description: Yoeja Goes Digital The echoes of Om Mani Padme Hung that resound over the hills and valleys of Bhutan will now reverberate around the digital world. And digital chyem(rosary), on the screen, ensures consistent and accurate recitation of the chant, preserving an accurate lifetime count. In today’s screen age, the spiritual practice of Yoeja has moved online, with the times. On October 22, 2026, His Majesty The King logged into yoeja.com, on his mobile phone, and became the first person to enter a digital prayer room. His Majesty recited the six-syllable mantra widely known across the Buddhist world, launching yoeja.com
